create_DecisionTreeRegressor: create a DecisionTreeRegressor with a specified max_depth parameter for regression
build_DecisionTreeRegressor_multi_depth: build multiple DecisionTreeRegressor models with different max_depth values to compare overfitting
fit_DecisionTreeRegressor: fit a DecisionTreeRegressor model on training data with features and target arrays
test_DecisionTreeRegressor_predict: test a fitted DecisionTreeRegressor by calling predict on a test feature array
plot_DecisionTree_regression: plot DecisionTreeRegressor predictions against original data using matplotlib scatter and line plots
